def transform(grid):
    # Collapse adjacent rows and columns with matching patterns after first
    # deleting columns that are not structurally stable vertical markers.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Keep columns containing a color occurring throughout that column as
    # a vertical guide; all other positions supply a repeated background.
    guide = []
    for j in range(w):
        vals = [grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) <= 4 and any(vals.count(v) >= h - 2 for v in set(vals)):
            guide.append(j)
    # Reduce rows by retaining distinct consecutive signatures off guide cols.
    rows=[]
    for row in grid:
        sig=tuple(row[j] for j in range(w) if j not in guide)
        if not rows or sig != tuple(rows[-1][j] for j in range(w) if j not in guide):
            rows.append(row[:])
    # Select columns at every transition in reduced row patterns.
    cols=[]; prev=None
    for j in range(w):
        sig=tuple(r[j] for r in rows)
        if sig != prev:
            cols.append(j); prev=sig
    return [[r[j] for j in cols] for r in rows]
PY
